title.narrative: Strengthening the ACCESS coalition to enable implementation of SDG7

description.narrative:
The main goal of the project is to strengthen the advocacy efforts of CSOs at national and regional levels to accelerate delivery of SDG7 on ensuring access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all by 2030.
Billions of people still live without energy. One billion lack modern electricity and three billion people do not have access to clean fuels and technologies. 87% of these people live in remote areas. without access to electricity grids, in the 'last mile'. SDG 7 recognises the importance of modern energy as an enabler of poverty reduction and its links to the delivery of other SDGs. In 2017, the Sustainable Energy for All (SEforALL) initiative quantified the potentially transformative benefits of this 'energy dividend' across a range of SDGs and argued that this could be delivered faster and more cost effectively in most contexts through deployment of decentralised electricity systems, mostly powered by renewables (DRE). However, SEforALL research has also shown the significant funding gap to reach SDG7, with less than 1% of the current, insufficient flows going to DRE and even less to clean cooking access.
Within energy planning, energy access, particularly for last mile communities, is given low political priority. The Alliance of CSOs for Clean Energy Access is a global coalition of 64 such organisations whose mission is to advocate for people living in poverty to have access to safe, reliable and affordable energy, and for environmentally sustainable and efficient energy systems globally. It aims to address three key problems: (1) lack of integration of the energy needs of poor communities in energy sector planning and decision-making; (2) lack of understanding/uptake by governments and investors of the evidence-based and innovative approaches needed to deliver SDG 7; and (3) lack of participation by communities and civil society in national and regional energy planning and decision making.
